A '''battle''' took place<ref name="Wild Space" /> on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]].<ref name="Wild Space" /> in the [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] the first [[Standard year/Legends|year]]<ref name="Wild Space Date" /> of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. During the battle, [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Eeth Koth/Legends|Eeth Koth]] led a detachment of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] to defend the besieged people of Korriban, but his [[Troop/Legends|troops]] suffered numerous [[Death/Legends|casualties]] against [[Unidentified anti-Republic force|their enemy]]. At the same [[Time/Legends|time]], while on a [[Mission to Zigoola|mission]] to the planet [[Zigoola]], Jedi Master [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] had a [[Force vision/Legends|vision]] of various members of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] fighting including Master Koth surrounded by [[Death/Legends|dead]] and dying [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]]s on Korriban.<ref name="Wild Space" />  

==Behind the scenes==
The battle was appeared as vision in ''[[The Clone Wars: Wild Space]]'', a [[2008]] novel written by [[Karen Miller]].<ref name="Wild Space" />
